integrity: The proof and exact rational example are self-contained; the seeded checker is corroborative only. Source chronology is the publicly dated online publication, not a later issue date.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-amplitude drawdown-duration surrogate does not solve river hydraulics or stage-specific empirical mortality.
Reaction latency is exponential; class-specific travel time is deterministic; survival requires an independent mortality clock to exceed the entire drawdown.
The threshold and global maxima apply only to two classes with shared positive latency and mortality rates and unconstrained duration.
No field calibration, operational fish-passage recommendation, or independent scientific validation is claimed.
Historical priority remains conditional on inspected primary literature and mathematical comparisons, including a closely related published Bateman mixture theorem.
title: A sharp global drawdown-duration switch for two fish-refuge classes
